locations.note: Fenton visits a Berlin cafe near the Brandenburg Gate.
The playable 1942 prologue follows Dr. Brunner in his Dresden home as the SS arrives.
The opening 1956 chapter sends Fenton through Port Said during the Suez Crisis.
Anna investigates Kessler's estate, forest, and bunker in Bavaria.
Anna and Fenton infiltrate the Moscow mausoleum and a Soviet underground facility.
The characters travel to Sandhurst as they follow the trail of the Viking artefact.
The player explores Jersey's harbor, pub, and lighthouse while searching for Professor Langtry.
The characters explore burial chambers and a stone circle on Gotland Island.
A chapter in Iceland follows the group's expedition camp and search for the passage to Asgard.

routes.name: Fenton's war and after
routes.note: A 1942 prologue in Dresden, then 1956 from Port Said through Bavaria, Berlin, Moscow, Sandhurst, Jersey and Gotland to Iceland, and back to Dresden at the end.
